author: A Google user
review_text: I shifted from NIBL internet banking to esewa (for mobile recharge). Although they have been termed banker of the year almost 6 times, their internet banking is too poor. I have faced difficulties couple of times, during fund transfers and mobile recharge. It would be unwise for me to give poor rating to this app just because NIBL is not in the list of partner banks. I am fully satisfied with esewa. Its been couple of weeks. For now 4 stars. Cheers to the dev team!  Is there by chance that you guys will be adding NIBL too?
